name: Optimum Tech
description: Software development and product consulting. Elixir and Phoenix development, faster development feedback, and coding-agent workflows.
about: Optimum Tech helps businesses decide what to build, develop the software, and put it to work. Clients work with Almir Sarajčić, who uses coding agents and takes responsibility for technical decisions, verification and the final result.

Bring an Elixir or Phoenix feature or repair, a development workflow that slows your team down, or a coding-agent workflow to improve on real tasks. We agree on an outcome, implementation, relevant checks and a usable handoff. AI features and product consulting can fit within an agreed project.

Our public portfolio links to product-owned websites and source repositories. Archived projects are identified as such; their inclusion does not imply current maintenance. The Optimum BH agency operated from 2022 to January 2026; Optimum Tech continues with products and consulting.
